svg.aria-label: Pull from the nearest node that has the layer: 1. Redirect: containerd on each node is pointed at a local mirror through host config written into /etc/cri/conf.d/hosts. 2. Locate: Each node announces the layers it holds to its peers. A pull asks the peers which node has the digest. 3. Serve: A peer that holds the layer serves it from its own containerd content store, over HTTP, inside the cluster. 4. Fall back: A miss, or a timeout, sends the pull to the upstream registry. A missing peer never fails a pull.
